page_download_channel_alpha_audience: Contributors and testers who accept breakage in exchange for the newest work.
page_download_channel_alpha_promise: The default while Atlas is in alpha. Fresh builds cut straight from main, with little soak. Features can be unfinished and behavior can change between builds.
page_download_channel_alpha_risk: Expect rough edges and breaking changes
page_download_channel_alpha_switch_to: You get the newest build of any channel, so a settings or config change may not be readable by an older Atlas. Going back to Beta or Stable later waits for a newer build there, or you can reinstall it explicitly.
page_download_channel_beta_audience: People who want next release's features a few weeks early and will report what breaks.
page_download_channel_beta_promise: Feature-complete builds that are being soaked before they become Stable. Only fixes land between betas.
page_download_channel_beta_risk: Mostly works; a bug can slip through
page_download_channel_beta_switch_to: You get the newest beta or release candidate, and Stable as soon as it is newer. Going back to Stable later waits for a Stable newer than your build, or you can reinstall Stable explicitly.
page_download_channel_stable_audience: Anyone who uses Atlas for real work and wants only soaked builds.
page_download_channel_stable_promise: Only builds that already ran as a beta, with nothing changed since but the version number.
page_download_channel_stable_switch_to: You move to the next Stable release that is newer than the version you run. Atlas never installs an older build by itself.
page_download_channel_stage_alpha_note: Atlas is in alpha. Every channel, including Stable, can have rough edges and breaking changes until the first release that meets the general availability criteria in the versioning policy.

match.channel=stable: The downloads above are the {label} channel. Beta and Alpha get new work sooner and break more often. You can switch at any time with {#code}atlas update channel{/code} or in Settings. The cards below link the {macos} {#code}.dmg{/code}; for {windows} or Linux, open the release page of the channel you want.
match.channel=*: The downloads above are the {label} channel, the default while Atlas is in alpha. Beta and Stable move slower and break less: Stable only ships builds that already ran as a beta. You can switch at any time with {#code}atlas update channel{/code} or in Settings. The cards below link the {macos} {#code}.dmg{/code}; for {windows} or Linux, open the release page of the channel you want.

page_download_cli_next_windows: Then run {#code}atlas desktop{/code} to install the app. {#link}Windows guide{/link}
page_download_cli_title: Or install the command line and the app from a terminal

page_download_description: Download Atlas for {macos} on Apple silicon, {windows} 10 and 11 (one-click Atlas-Setup.exe) and Linux x86_64 (Arch, .deb, .rpm and AppImage). Intel Macs, {windows} on Arm and Linux on Arm are coming soon.
page_download_lead: The desktop app and the {#code}atlas{/code} command line, in one download. Free and open source.
page_download_lin_sub: x86_64: Arch, Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora and more.
page_download_mac_intel_note: This download is for Apple silicon (M1 or later). Intel Macs are coming soon: use "{cta}" below.
page_download_phone_text: Atlas runs on a computer. Send yourself the link and open it there.
page_download_req_linux: x86_64 with glibc 2.35 or newer (Arch, Fedora, Debian 12, Ubuntu 22.04 or newer) and WebKitGTK 4.1
page_download_req_macos: 13 Ventura or later, Apple silicon (M1 or later)
page_download_req_optional: git and gh for worktrees and pull requests; Docker (OrbStack or Docker Desktop) if your atlas.yaml has an infra: block
page_download_req_windows: 10 (version 1809 or newer) or 11, 64-bit (x64). Arm PCs run it through emulation. Needs WebView2, which comes with Windows 11.
page_download_soon_note: {windows} on Arm runs the x64 build through emulation today. Intel Macs and Linux on Arm have no ready-made downloads yet. Until then you can build the command line from source: {#link}build from source{/link}.
page_download_soon_text: Atlas is built to run anywhere you write code. Tell us where you want it and we will email you when it ships.
page_download_soon_windows_arm_note: native arm64 (the x64 build runs through emulation today)
page_download_terminals_note: Terminals in Atlas Desktop use the native GPU terminal on {macos} and xterm.js on {windows} and Linux. Capture and recording, and the agent test instances, are {macos} only.
page_download_verify_text: Every download has a SHA-256 checksum, a fingerprint that shows the file was not changed. The checksums below come from the latest release. Check yours with {#code}shasum -a 256 <file>{/code} (on Linux: {#code}sha256sum <file>{/code}; in PowerShell: {#code}Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <file>{/code}). Every file on the {#link}release page{/link}, {#code}Atlas-Setup.exe{/code} included, also has a {#code}.sha256{/code} file next to it.
page_download_win_smartscreen: This installer is not signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Click {#b}More info{/b}, then {#b}Run anyway{/b}. Signing through SignPath Foundation is pending ({#policy}Code signing policy{/policy}). You can compare the file's {#sha}SHA-256{/sha} checksum with the one on the release page.
page_download_win_sub: Windows 10 (1809 or newer) and 11, x64. Installs for your user only, no admin rights needed.
